title: Delivery creation initiates lifecycle
gherkin:
Given a new delivery is created
When the delivery is registered in the system
Then the delivery should be in the initial state of the lifecycle
rationale: Validates that a delivery enters the lifecycle management system upon creation with an appropriate initial state
generationSummary: Delivery lifecycle management rule - Test suite covering the management and progression of delivery states through their lifecycle stages

title: Delivery progresses through valid lifecycle states
gherkin:
Given a delivery exists in the system
When the delivery transitions to the next valid state
Then the delivery state should be updated accordingly
rationale: Ensures deliveries can progress through defined lifecycle states in the correct sequence
generationSummary: Delivery lifecycle management rule - Test suite covering the management and progression of delivery states through their lifecycle stages

title: Invalid state transitions are prevented
gherkin:
Given a delivery in a specific lifecycle state
When an invalid state transition is attempted
Then the transition should be rejected and the delivery should remain in its current state
rationale: Validates that the lifecycle management enforces valid state transitions and prevents invalid ones

title: Delivery lifecycle state is tracked
gherkin:
Given a delivery progresses through multiple states
When the delivery history is queried
Then all state transitions should be recorded and retrievable
rationale: Ensures the system maintains an audit trail of delivery lifecycle state changes

title: Delivery reaches completion state
gherkin:
Given a delivery progresses through all required lifecycle states

title: Delivery lifecycle state is queryable

When the current lifecycle state is queried

title: Multiple deliveries maintain independent lifecycles

title: Delivery state change triggers appropriate actions
